cases.query: How much annual leave do full-time employees receive?
cases.claim: Full-time employees receive 15 paid leave days each year.

contexts.text: Full-time employees receive 15 paid leave days each calendar year. Unused days do not roll over.

cases.query: How often is customer data backed up?
cases.claim: Customer data is backed up every six hours.

contexts.text: Customer data is encrypted at rest and in transit. The overview does not specify a backup schedule.

cases.query: How many remote-work days are allowed?
cases.claim: Employees may work remotely three days per week.

contexts.text: Employees may work remotely up to two days per week. A third remote day is not permitted without an accommodation.

cases.query: What is required for travel reimbursement?
cases.claim: Travel reimbursement requires itemized receipts and approval from both a manager and the finance director.

contexts.text: Travel reimbursement requires itemized receipts and the employee's manager must approve the expense report.

cases.query: Can all paid customers use the beta feature?
cases.claim: All paid customers can use the beta feature.

contexts.text: The beta feature is being enabled gradually for eligible paid accounts. Eligibility criteria are not described here.
